hypotheses.statement: Material-line stretching is locally governed by the rate-of-strain tensor projected onto the tangent vector (d ln(dl)/dt = t^T S t).
hypotheses.conditions: Valid everywhere within Navier-Stokes continuum and staggered grid interpolation.

hypotheses.statement: Material-thread stretching is a universal proxy for local vortex intensification.
hypotheses.conditions: Thread stretching and vortex stretching decouple due to misalignment with the eigen-directions of the strain tensor.

hypotheses.statement: 1D material threads retain sufficient geometric information to outperform point-particle histories universally.
hypotheses.conditions: In isotropic turbulence, 1D thread geometry collapses in predictive capability compared to single point tracers.

hypotheses.statement: Multi-directional 3D material bundles (P2) improve predictive power over 1D material lines (P1).
hypotheses.conditions: 3D bundles increase feature dimensionality without providing additional predictive signal across held-out flows.

hypotheses.statement: Temporal ordering of Lagrangian history carries causal signal beyond time-shuffled trajectories.
hypotheses.conditions: Modest positive causal effect preserved, most prominent in structured anisotropic flows.

hypotheses.statement: Lagrangian thread geometric features provide complementary predictive lift when added to instantaneous Eulerian physics.
hypotheses.conditions: Instantaneous Eulerian strain, vorticity, and velocity gradients dominate future state prediction.

hypotheses.statement: Point-particle trajectory history provides complementary lift when added to Eulerian physics.
hypotheses.conditions: Point particle trajectories provide modest lift in homogeneous isotropic turbulence, but not in structured laminar shear flows.

hypotheses.statement: The predictive utility of material connectivity is topologically conditioned on flow structure (TH2).
hypotheses.conditions: Material connectivity is positive in coherent shear/vortex flows and negative in fully developed isotropic turbulence.

hypotheses.statement: Absolute spatial coordinates outperform intrinsic coordinate deformation metrics due to genuine physical transport.
hypotheses.conditions: Absolute position coordinates do not improve generalization across independent flows and introduce risk of spatial phase leakage.

hypotheses.statement: Grid resolutions of 16^3 at Re >= 100 represent marginal or under-resolved DNS requiring resolution tracking.
hypotheses.conditions: DNS resolution criterion (k_max * eta >= 1.0) requires finer grids as Re increases.

hypotheses.statement: Decaying 3D Navier-Stokes turbulence preserves material line stretching dynamics without continuing forcing.
hypotheses.conditions: Unforced decaying turbulence dissipates kinetic energy gradually over integral eddy turnover times.

hypotheses.statement: The exploratory ~0.96 AUC reported in earlier experiments was an artifact of same-flow random data splitting.
hypotheses.conditions: Random sample splitting within the same flow causes catastrophic spatial and target leakage, creating an illusion of high predictive accuracy.
